body:
**Yogyakarta, October 16, 2026.** The Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) team at Universitas Gadjah Mada conducted a comprehensive deep cleaning at the Smart Agri Plant Factory on Friday (16/10). This activity was carried out in preparation for transplanting to ensure the facility is ready to resume operations and support optimal plant cultivation.

The cleaning was carried out by Ardan Desta Vaunendra, Rizqi Asy'ari Ramadhan, M. Fajar Ridho Ilham, and Samuel Gatot Murseno. The team prepared the cultivation area before plants were moved into the facility. This stage gave the team the opportunity to ensure the planting area was ready for use before cultivation activities resumed.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1097-1-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.27.13-edited-1030x565.webp)

A plant factory is an indoor cultivation facility with a controlled growing environment. As transplanting approaches, the readiness of the facility becomes one of the important aspects that must be considered. Comprehensive cleaning is conducted to ensure the cultivation area is organized and ready for use before plants enter, so that the maintenance process can run more optimally.

"We conduct cleaning before transplanting so that preparation of the cultivation area can be done more freely. After the plants enter, the team can focus more on monitoring plant conditions and implementing routine maintenance," said Ardan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1097-2-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.30.27-edited-1.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1097-3-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.30.26-edited-1.webp)

Transplanting becomes the next stage after preparation of the cultivation area. Through this activity, the SmartAgri UGM team prepares the Plant Factory to resume operations and can be used to support the next cultivation cycle.

## Linkage with the SDGs

- **SDG 2 – Zero Hunger**, through the preparation of indoor food crop cultivation facilities for the next planting cycle.
- **SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure**, through the maintenance of the Plant Factory as a research and development facility for indoor cultivation technology.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 16 Oktober 2026.** Tim Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada melakukan pembersihan menyeluruh (_deep cleaning_) di Smart Agri Plant Factory, Jumat (16/10). Kegiatan ini dilakukan sebagai persiapan pindah tanam agar fasilitas siap kembali beroperasi dan mendukung budi daya tanaman secara optimal.

Pembersihan dilakukan oleh Ardan Desta Vaunendra, Rizqi Asy’ari Ramadhan, M. Fajar Ridho Ilham, dan Samuel Gatot Murseno. Tim menyiapkan area budi daya sebelum tanaman dipindahkan ke dalam fasilitas. Tahap ini memberi tim kesempatan untuk memastikan area tanam siap digunakan sebelum kegiatan budi daya dimulai kembali.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1097-1-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.27.13-edited-1030x565.webp)

Plant factory merupakan fasilitas budi daya dalam ruang dengan lingkungan tumbuh yang dapat dikendalikan. Menjelang pindah tanam, kesiapan fasilitas menjadi salah satu aspek penting yang perlu diperhatikan. Pembersihan menyeluruh dilakukan untuk memastikan area budi daya tertata dan siap digunakan sebelum tanaman masuk, sehingga proses pemeliharaan dapat berjalan lebih optimal.

“Kami melakukan pembersihan sebelum pindah tanam agar persiapan area budi daya dapat dilakukan dengan lebih leluasa. Setelah tanaman masuk, tim dapat lebih fokus pada pemantauan kondisi tanaman dan pelaksanaan pemeliharaan rutin,” ujar Ardan.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1097-2-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.30.27-edited-1.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1097-3-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.30.26-edited-1.webp)

Pindah tanam menjadi tahap berikutnya setelah persiapan area budi daya. Melalui kegiatan ini, tim SmartAgri UGM menyiapkan Plant Factory agar kembali beroperasi dan dapat digunakan untuk mendukung siklus budi daya berikutnya.

## Keterkaitan dengan SDGs

-   **SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan**, melalui penyiapan fasilitas budi daya tanaman pangan dalam ruang untuk siklus tanam berikutnya.
-   **SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur**, melalui pemeliharaan Plant Factory sebagai fasilitas riset dan pengembangan teknologi budi daya dalam ruang.
